title: Operations Supervisor - Freight Forwarding
description: Official Al-Dawaa freight-forwarding operations role in Saudi Arabia focused on managing end-to-end sea and air shipment flow. The role covers carrier and freight-forwarder coordination, rate negotiation, customs-clearance coordination, import/export compliance for medical equipment, food items, and consumables, Letter of Credit shipment handling, operational reporting, issue resolution, and cross-functional coordination with customs, logistics, and procurement teams. The listing asks for 3-4 years of freight-forwarding, logistics, or operations-management experience plus strong knowledge of Saudi import/export procedures.
